title.es: Suponiendo que, por si acaso, aunque

es: Reconocer supposing, in case, even if y what if y el matiz de cada uno frente a if.

teaching.en: Supposing the flight is delayed, what will we do?
teaching.es: Suponiendo que el vuelo se retrase, ¿qué haremos?
teaching.explanationEs: Supposing + presente propone una hipótesis para pensar en una posibilidad.
teaching.audioText: Supposing the flight is delayed, what will we do?

teaching.en: Take a spare charger in case the battery dies.
teaching.es: Lleva un cargador de repuesto por si se acaba la batería.
teaching.explanationEs: In case no significa «si»: es una precaución, algo que haces ahora por si pasa algo después.
teaching.audioText: Take a spare charger in case the battery dies.

teaching.en: We will sleep in a tent even if it rains.
teaching.es: Dormiremos en una tienda de campaña aunque llueva.
teaching.explanationEs: Even if es una concesión: la condición no cambia lo que haremos.
teaching.audioText: We will sleep in a tent even if it rains.

teaching.en: What if they cancel our booking?
teaching.es: ¿Y si cancelan nuestra reserva?
teaching.explanationEs: What if + presente pregunta por una posibilidad, a menudo con preocupación.
teaching.audioText: What if they cancel our booking?

teaching.en: If the company cancels the trip, we get a refund.
teaching.es: Si la empresa cancela el viaje, nos devuelven el dinero.
teaching.explanationEs: If + presente es la condición normal: si pasa A, ocurre B. Compárala con in case.
teaching.audioText: If the company cancels the trip, we get a refund.

prompt.es: Escribe una nota a tu yo del pasado, de 90 a 140 palabras.

answer.text: Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had taken more chances at school, I would be more confident today. I regret that I never had the courage to try new things, and I know it is hard. Supposing you feel afraid before an exam, remember that every mistake is a lesson. Even if people laugh at your dreams, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you are stronger than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I will always be on your side. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.
accepted: Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had taken more chances at school, I would be more confident today. I regret that I never had the courage to try new things, and I know it is hard. Supposing you feel afraid before an exam, remember that every mistake is a lesson. Even if people laugh at your dreams, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you are stronger than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I will always be on your side. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.

Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had worked harder at school, I would have more choices today. My biggest regret is that I did not have the courage to ask for help. Supposing you feel lost, remember that every mistake teaches you something. Even if it is difficult, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you can do more than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I know you can do it. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.
